5.0.3.title: Fixed a Download That Wouldn't Stay Finished
highlights: Fixed a bug where a download recovering from an expired link could get wrongly marked as failed while it was actually still finishing — the app would then look like it "restarted" a completed download. Thanks to Kaizo for reporting this one with logs, which made it possible to track down.
Downloads should now recover cleanly from expired links and mirror switches without any UI weirdness.

5.0.2.title: Space, Mirrors, Priority
highlights: Free space is now shown in Settings and while downloads are running — you'll get a warning if space gets tight mid-download instead of finding out the hard way.
Mirror auto-switching now catches a few more failure types, and you'll actually see it happen ("Switched mirrors ×2") instead of it being invisible.
Drag a queued download to the top of the list to have it start first.
This popup! You'll see what changed right after every update from now on.

5.0.0.title: A Fresh Coat of Neon
highlights: The whole app got a visual revamp — same neon look, cleaner everywhere.
Status badges are now color-coded so you can tell downloading/completed/failed/paused apart at a glance.
Settings panel got restyled toggle switches and a proper dropdown.
Toast notifications for things like "Settings saved" and "History cleared".
